name: Get-WinEvent
title: Review Recent Windows Event Log Errors
summary: Reads structured events from Windows logs to gather crash and system evidence.

examples.description: Shows up to 20 application errors from the last day.

permissions.notes: Some logs require an elevated PowerShell session.

risk.warning: Event details may contain usernames, device names, or file paths; review before sharing.

common_errors.meaning: No events matched the selected log, time, and severity filters.
The selected log requires elevated access.
